summary: Newell Brands filed an 8-K reporting entry into a five-year asset-based revolving credit facility (ABL) on July 30, 2026, with JPMorgan Chase as administrative agent. The facility provides up to $800 million, subject to a borrowing base, plus an uncommitted accordion up to $500 million. Proceeds included $490 million borrowed to repay and replace the existing 2022 credit agreement. The filing is a routine financing agreement, not a special situation. No deal terms, strategic event, or shareholder action are involved.
